between: VCCA = +1V5_RADAR, A1 = TDet, A2 = PDet; DIR = VCCA
circuit.page: [this design; 0.65-3.6 V each side per JLCPCB listing]

supplies.VDD: 1.45-1.6 V ONLY (abs max 1.9 V; I/O abs max VDD + 0.3 V) (p3-4)
supplies.I_avg_3V3_mA: about 3.7 at PRT 500 us (5.6 mW / 1.5 V, linear LDO) + LDO 25 uA
supplies.ramp: supply ramp must be shorter than 400 us (AN625 p7)
supplies.off: LDO EN low: 0 A to the radar

logic: 1.5 V I/O only. TDet (active low) and PDet are 1.5 V outputs: a 3.3 V port expander cannot read them (VIH 0.7 x 3.3 V), so a 2-bit translator raises them. Nothing else is connected in autonomous mode.

expander: RADAR_TD_N (input via translator; the expander's INT can wake the brain on motion)

placement: Antennas radiate from the top face: no copper, battery, e-paper, metal frame or screws in the beam (+-50 deg H, +-70 deg E at -6 dB, p6). Put it at a board edge or end where only plastic covers it.

Radome (case plastic) distance and thickness [mem, Infineon radar radome guidance]: thickness about lambda/2 in the material (lambda0 = 4.9 mm at 61 GHz; about 1.4-1.5 mm for PC/ABS, er about 2.8-3) or as thin as possible (<0.3 mm); air gap from the package top to the radome about lambda0/2 = 2.4 mm (or a multiple). No paint with metal flakes over it.
Vtune pin floating with no trace attached (ref guide p14); short crystal traces; 4-layer board with solid ground under the package (ref guide p14).
Keep the 38.4 MHz crystal and the pulsed 128 mA supply away from the LMH2110 tap and the microphones.
notes: Autonomous pulsed mode: no SPI, no firmware; settings fixed by straps. Advance mode (PLL_Trig high) unlocks 16 thresholds/holds via the resistor dividers and the PRT straps (ref guide p15-17).
SPI mode later: SPICS/SPICLK/SPIDI/SPIDO/SPIRSTN would need 1.5 V-level lines from the brain (another translator); kept as pads only.
IFI/IFQ (raw baseband around VDD/2, under 1.5 V) could go to the spare 1.8 V-reference ADC input (AIN_SPARE) for breathing/vibration experiments [suggestion].
unverified: TDet/PDet output type (push-pull assumed; the reference board drives LEDs from them, p13).
Which side of the QS dividers goes to VDD (R11/R14 assumed to VDD from fig 11).
Pairing of hold/high-pass capacitors with the IF pins (fig 8-9 read as o<->i, ox<->ix).
